reviewsSection.title: What Our Guests Say
reviewsSection.noRatingLine: A selection of experiences our guests have shared on Google

1.text: We absolutely loved this place. We stayed two nights and are checking out today, and I'm genuinely sad to leave. Finding such a beautiful view and such a peaceful spot to spend two days was an incredible experience. We stayed in the one-bedroom suites; the fine decorative touches in the rooms and the magnificent view towards Lesbos were simply lovely. There was even a fireplace, but our view was so beautiful that we spent all our time on the balcony. The owners have thought of every detail — it feels less like a hotel and more as if they designed their own home. Breakfast was ample and delicious. The hotel's mascots, Ares and Tarçın, are affectionate, well-trained dogs, and we had a wonderful time with them too. Peerless views, wonderful peace — highly recommended.

2.text: As a family, our two-night stay in the one-bedroom suites at Karadut Taş Otel exceeded our expectations. Attentive, friendly staff, clean and comfortable rooms, a magnificent view and quiet, a superb location to unwind — it truly deserves its five stars. Although the hotel is 7–8 minutes from the coast, the free access to the beach at their own guesthouse in Kadırga Bay is fantastic. In short, I felt proud to have a place like this; from now on I'd love to spend a few days here every year to recharge. My thanks to everyone involved.

3.text: Karadut Otel was our accommodation of choice during our Assos holiday. It's a lovely family-run business. Yağız and his family are both very warm and very professional; they met all our needs with patience. The rooms are clean and airy, and the distance between the apartments gives enough privacy. We loved the infinity pool too; it has a perfect view. There is also a children's pool, and the pool was spotless and well kept. When we booked by phone we got a much better rate than online — I'd suggest reaching them via their contact number.

about.p1: Set among the unspoilt nature of Assos in Büyükhusun village, our 28-room hotel welcomes guests with bed-and-breakfast and half-board options. The warmth of traditional stone architecture meets a modern sense of comfort.
about.p2: Just 5 km from Kadırga Bay and minutes from ancient Assos, the hotel is an ideal base for those who want to experience the sea, history and nature all in one holiday.

story.p1: Assos Karadut Taş Otel rises in the quiet beauty of Büyükhusun village, in a unique setting that opens onto the blue of the Aegean. With 28 rooms and both bed-and-breakfast and half-board options, we blend traditional stone architecture with a modern sense of comfort.
story.p2: Just 5 km from Kadırga Bay and minutes from ancient Assos and Assos Harbour, our hotel is tailor-made for those who wish to bring together the Aegean's history, nature and sea in a single holiday.
story.p3Suffix: on TripAdvisor is the finest reflection of the service and the setting we offer.
story.seasonalText: We are open from April to October.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To make guests feel the warmth of home away from home, and to help them experience the nature of the Aegean and the history of Assos to the fullest.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To be the finest boutique hotel in the Assos region and to lead sustainable tourism by keeping traditional stone architecture alive.

certified.title: Ministry of Culture Certified
certified.desc: We are a licensed accommodation certified by the Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism (Licence No: 24921).

features.p1: Our sea-view outdoor pool and separate children's pool welcome every age group. The poolside bar keeps you refreshed while adding to the pleasure.
features.p2: Our à la carte restaurant serves Aegean flavours prepared with fresh local ingredients, along with made-to-order breakfast (08:30–10:30).

intro.title: Comfort Set in Stone
intro.text: Our hotel offers 3 room types, and every room is equipped with air conditioning, TV, Wi-Fi, a minibar, a wardrobe and a private bathroom. With our sea-view options, take in the Aegean right from your room.

deluxe.desc: Wake to a sea view each morning through windows that open onto the magnificent blue of the Aegean. Designed with modern comfort across 24 m², with air conditioning for a comfortable stay in every season.

traditional.desc: This 22 m² room offers a partial Aegean view along with all standard comforts. With air conditioning, TV and minibar, it is the ideal choice for guests seeking a relaxed stay.

family.desc: At 44 m², this is our largest room. Designed for a spacious, relaxed holiday with your family, it accommodates up to 4 guests. With a separate sitting area and an outdoor dining table, it offers the full comfort of a family holiday.

s1.p: Under Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK"), your personal data may be processed by {hotelName} (the "Hotel") acting as data controller, within the scope described below.

s2.p: In connection with your reservation, contact form and accommodation processes, personal data such as your full name, phone number, email address, stay dates, number of guests and the content of your requests/complaints is processed.

items.3: Responding to enquiries submitted via the contact form and other requests
items.4: Fulfilling legal obligations (accommodation tax, official notifications, etc.)

s4.p: Your personal data may be transferred to authorised public institutions where required by our legal obligations, and to the service providers operating our reservation and email infrastructure (hosting/email/payment infrastructure providers), strictly limited to the performance of the service. Your data is not transferred abroad; should an infrastructure requiring such a transfer be used, this notice will be updated. [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK]

s5.p: Your personal data is retained for the periods prescribed by applicable legislation (e.g. accommodation records under tax and accounting law) or for as long as the processing purpose requires. Exact retention periods: [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK].

s6.intro: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, everyone has the right, by applying to the data controller, to:

items.1: Learn whether their personal data is being processed,
items.3: Learn the purpose of the processing and whether the data is used in line with that purpose,
items.4: Know the third parties to whom the data is transferred, in Turkey or abroad,
items.5: Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data,
items.6: Request erasure or destruction of the data under the conditions set out in Article 7 of the KVKK,
items.7: Request that corrections/erasures be notified to third parties to whom the data was transferred,
items.8: Object to a result arising against them from analysis of the processed data exclusively by automated systems,
items.9: Claim compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing.

s6.outro: To exercise these rights, you may send your requests to {email} or to the postal address above.

s1.p: This privacy policy explains how the information collected while you use the {hotelName} website (the "Site") is processed. For detailed information on the processing of personal data, please see the <kvkkLink>KVKK Privacy Notice</kvkkLink>.

s2.p: The Site may use strictly necessary cookies for core functionality. Analytics/marketing cookies are only enabled if you give consent via the cookie bar at the bottom of the page. You can change your preference through the local storage (localStorage) kept in your browser.

s3.p: The name, email, phone number and message content you submit via the reservation and contact forms, as well as anonymous usage statistics such as page views (if analytics is enabled), may be collected.

s4.p: Your data is protected against unauthorised access with reasonable technical and administrative measures. The contact form and reservation system are protected against spam and abuse with security verification (Cloudflare Turnstile) and rate limiting.

s5.p: Third-party service providers are used for email delivery and the reservation infrastructure. These providers process your data solely for the performance of the service. [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK — kullanılan sağlayıcıların güncel listesi]

s6.p: For questions about this policy, you can reach us at {email}.

s1.p: Reservations at {hotelName} are confirmed through a request created on the website followed by a deposit payment. If the deposit is not paid within {hours} hours of your reservation request being created, the request is cancelled automatically and your selected dates become available again.

s2.intro: When a reservation confirmed by deposit payment is cancelled by the guest, the following conditions apply:

items.1: For cancellations made [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK] days before the check-in date, the deposit is refunded in full.
items.2: For cancellations made after that period, the deposit is partly or fully non-refundable according to the [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK] condition.
items.3: In the event of a no-show (failure to arrive without notice), the deposit is non-refundable.

s3.p: If the hotel cancels a reservation due to force majeure or an unforeseeable circumstance, the deposit paid is refunded to the guest in full, or transferred to an alternative date at the guest's request.

s4.h: 4. Right of Withdrawal under Distance Sales Rules
s4.p: Under Turkish Consumer Protection Law No. 6502 and the Distance Contracts Regulation, accommodation services may be treated as services to be performed on a specific date; please review the applicable legislation or contact us regarding the conditions for exercising the right of withdrawal. Exact conditions: [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK].

s5.p: Approved refunds are made to the account the deposit was paid from within [OTEL SAHİBİ ONAYLAYACAK] business days of the notification date.

s6.p: For cancellation, change and refund requests, please call us at <phoneLink>{phone}</phoneLink> or email {email}.
